name: Should I choose quartz or granite for my new countertops?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose quartz or granite for my new countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between quartz and granite depends on your priorities. Quartz is an engineered material, offering consistent patterns, a non-porous surface for easy cleaning, and excellent stain resistance. Granite is a natural stone, providing unique variations in color and pattern, and is very heat resistant. While both are durable, granite requires sealing, whereas quartz does not. Consider your aesthetic preferences, maintenance tolerance, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose quartz for consistency, low maintenance, and stain resistance; choose granite for unique natural patterns and heat resistance, but note it requires sealing.
